answer: A Sybil farm tries to flood the network with clones, but we anchor trust at a verified vertex—the single attested origin that every honest path must trace back to. In the grove of established agents, each node broadcasts a timed pulse of its unique hardware fingerprint; clones fail the latency and entropy match because fabricating a coherent grove of pulses costs more compute than the reward. Peers reject any signal that does not ripple cleanly from the vertex. The farm ends up gardening its own failure.
